\documentclass[12pt,border=10pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{blogfigure}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  bit/.style={draw=ink,line width=1pt,minimum size=9.5mm,inner sep=0pt},
  odd/.style={bit,figure solid},even/.style={bit,fill=paper},
  deal odd/.style={figure emph arrow},
  deal even/.style={figure arrow,dashed}]
  \def\p{1.3}
  \FigureMasthead{-2.3}{13.8}{2.35}{}{}
  % Each bit keeps its column; odd bits drop one row, even bits two, so no arrows cross.
  % Odd = solid ink (white digit), even = paper; arrows heavy vs dashed.
  \node[anchor=east] at (-0.1,0) {$U = 0.$};
  \node[anchor=east] at (-0.1,-2.2) {$U_1 = 0.$};
  \node[anchor=east] at (-0.1,-4.4) {$U_2 = 0.$};
  \foreach \i in {1,...,10} {
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\x}{(\i-1)*\p+0.6}
    \ifodd\i
      \node[odd] (t\i) at (\x,0) {$b_{\i}$};
      \node[odd] (d\i) at (\x,-2.2) {$b_{\i}$};
      \draw[deal odd] (t\i.south) -- (d\i.north);
    \else
      \node[even] (t\i) at (\x,0) {$b_{\i}$};
      \node[even] (d\i) at (\x,-4.4) {$b_{\i}$};
      \draw[deal even] (t\i.south) -- (d\i.north);
    \fi
  }
  \foreach \y in {0,-2.2,-4.4} \node at (10*\p+0.45,\y) {$\cdots$};
  \FigureFootRule{-2.3}{13.8}{-5.35}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
